Carnival Corporation reported record full-year 2023 revenues of $21.6 billion and record fourth-quarter revenues of $5.4 billion, with positive adjusted net income for the full year. The company also entered 2024 with its best booked position on record for both price and occupancy, and total customer deposits reached a fourth-quarter record of $6.4 billion.
records.catalyst: Record full-year and fourth-quarter revenues, positive adjusted net income for the full year, and a record booked position for 2024 indicate strong demand and financial recovery.
